title: Agreement outside specified cells
statement: Let $d$ and $d'$ be configurations with the same input and work tapes indexed by $j<k$, and for each tape $j$ let $F_j\subseteq\mathbb Z$ be a set of cell positions. The configurations agree outside these sets if, for every tape $j$ and every position $q\notin F_j$, the contents of cell $q$ on tape $j$ are the same in $d$ and $d'$.
hypotheses_covered: Two configurations $d,d'$ with the same input and tape count
A set $F_j$ of integer positions for each work tape $j$
